correctness.rationale: For K_{n,n} missing the complete rectangle A^0×B^0, the finite-state admissible-edge transition weights are exactly xv, uy, uv. Independent rate-1/n edge clocks yield the Lipschitz four-population drift (−XV,−U(Y+V),−YU,−V(X+U)); bounded jumps and martingale quadratic variation O(T/n) give compact-time law of large numbers. Balanced side masses and θ=e^(−∫K), W=∫θ solve the ODE explicitly; W tends to a finite root, yielding the asserted divided-difference jam density, with continuous diagonal αexp(−(1−α)/α). A finite-time consumption bound involving remaining good vertices transfers ODE convergence to *terminal* jam time. Hall feasibility iff a+b≤n and strict concavity/increase of g(s)=log s+1−1/s prove L≤1/(2e), equality uniquely at α=β=1/2. Independent exact rational chain checks through n=8 and positive-density numerical evaluation are corroborative, not asymptotic proof.
